price_type_gold.semantics: User SPENDS gold (free server-bound currency) and RECEIVES gems (paid account-wide)

price_type_gems.semantics: User SPENDS gems (paid) and RECEIVES various rewards (stamina/gold/exp/gacha)

perspective_A_account_wide.reasoning: shop_purchases tracks historical purchases for daily limits (purchase_counts in GET /api/shop). Since gems are account-wide, paid-purchase history should be visible across all server profiles to prevent stockpile abuse.
evidence: GET /api/shop queries shop_purchases filtered by user_id + date only (no server_id filter)
purchase_counts is used for purchase-cap enforcement, which is account-wide for paid items

perspective_B_server_bound.reasoning: Daily reset is server day-bound; gold-priced items (gems_small/medium/large) consume free server-bound currency, so their history is naturally per-server.
evidence: date field uses server timezone implicitly via datetime.utcnow()
gold balance is currently account-wide but classified as FREE_SERVER_BOUND_CANDIDATE in V2 BLOCK_C

perspective_C_split_by_item_type.reasoning: Mixed schema: gold-priced purchases (3) -> server-bound; gem-priced purchases (7) -> account-wide. Requires PER-ITEM classification.
evidence: price_type field already discriminates the 2 buckets cleanly
Could be implemented at insert-time without DB migration if a new collection split is acceptable

canonical_classification.summary: shop_purchases is intrinsically MIXED. La decisione canonical richiede signoff prodotto perché ogni alternativa ha trade-off operativi non risolvibili a livello tecnico puro.
canonical_classification.why_not_metadata_only: Aggiungere `server_id` indiscriminatamente romperebbe la verifica di purchase_counts cross-server per gem items (paid). Aggiungere solo a una metà richiederebbe una nuova logica di selezione che cambia il behavior dello shop. Entrambe sono cambi product-level.

recommended_decision_buckets.question: I limiti di acquisto giornaliero (purchase_counts) devono essere account-wide o server-bound?

options.impact: Tutte le purchase rimangono senza server_id; lo shop è globale. Semplice ma riduce il vantaggio competitivo nei singoli server.
Tutte le purchase ricevono server_id; un giocatore può fare la stessa daily quest in N server. Più grind ma più paid-friendly.
gold-priced -> server-bound; gems-priced -> account-wide. Più coerente economicamente ma richiede 2 query path.

recommended_decision_buckets.question: La promo/sale rotation dello shop è globale o per-server?

options.impact: Tutti i server vedono gli stessi item rotation. Operazionalmente semplice.
Ogni server può avere il proprio shop rotation. Più complesso ma più engagement.

safe_future_micro_batches.name: NONE_SAFE_UNTIL_DECISION
safe_future_micro_batches.reasoning: Nessun micro-batch metadata-only è sicuro senza la product decision sopra. Anche `ensure_server_scope` indiscriminato cambierebbe semantica.

next_recommended_action: Product decision board review per DECISION_1 e DECISION_2 prima di qualsiasi micro-batch su W01.
